text: Bitcoin is holding steady with modest gains, but Ethereum is outpacing it with 3.6% upside, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite a Fear-dominant sentiment reading of 30. BTC dominance at 56.5% and subdued 24-hour volume of $45B indicate cautious positioning—the market is testing higher but without conviction or broad participation. The slight uptick in Fear & Greed over the past week hints at stabilization after deeper pessimism, though traders remain defensive.
